entries:
Alpha 1.79.50 (World stability and town presentation)

  • Fixes an unsafe interaction between periodic elite spawning and multiplayer world updates that could crash the server.
  • Lanternhold homes gain leaded-glass detail, warm pane variation and physical surface response on their existing windows.
  • Character rendering avoids repeated temporary allocations and duplicate skeleton checks while preserving equipment, animation, geometry and shadows.
  • Retains quest pacing improvements, connected town paving, Dark Realm masonry, smooth jumps and steady Well Rested auras.
  • Class specialization and rune redesign, crowded-scene performance and release-readiness work continue. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.49 (Dark Realm masonry and connected town services)

  • Dark Realm district walls gain staggered basalt courses, recessed mortar and restrained weathering, with matching surface detail on High and Low quality.
  • Scene transitions and logout clean up active building cutaways and their surfaces.
  • Lanternhold's merchant and forge gain paved standing areas connected to their nearby lanes.
  • Compatible character parts share rendering submissions while preserving their exact appearance, full geometry, equipment, animations and shadows.
  • Retains smooth roughly 1.5-second jumps, steady Well Rested auras, gradual quest rewards, click-to-type map search and separate test-account reporting.
  • World art, crowded-town performance and release-readiness work continues. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.48 (Connected town services and character rendering)

  • Lanternhold's merchant and forge gain paved standing areas connected to their nearby lanes, making service stops feel part of the town.
  • Compatible character parts share rendering submissions while retaining their exact appearance, full geometry, equipment, animations and shadows on High and Low quality.
  • Character rendering follows equipment changes, graphics settings and realm transitions, retiring old buffers as their owners change.
  • Retains roughly 1.5-second smooth jumps, Well Rested aura tracking, gradual quest rewards, click-to-type map search and separate test-account reporting.
  • World art and crowded-town performance work continues. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.47 (Town shadows and steadier geometry downloads)

  • Lanternhold buildings and courtyards share compatible shadow submissions on High quality, retaining their exact appearance and shadows alongside equipped characters. Low quality keeps its existing shadow settings.
  • Prepared character geometry downloads arrive in smaller cached pieces, reducing the size of each request while preserving the original models, equipment and animations.
  • Retains timber homes with side windows and stove flues, strolling residents, connected lanes and blended town-to-Earth roads.
  • Retains roughly 1.5-second smooth jumps, Well Rested aura tracking, gradual quest rewards, click-to-type map search and separate test-account reporting.
  • World art and crowded-town performance work continues. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.46 (Lanternhold windows and shadows)

  • Lanternhold homes gain framed side windows and seated stove flues, giving the neighborhood more detail as you walk its streets.
  • Compatible character parts share shadow submissions on High quality while preserving their full geometry, equipment and rendered shadows. Low quality keeps its existing shadow settings.
  • Retains weathered timber, smooth foreground-home visibility, strolling residents, connected lanes and blended town-to-Earth roads.
  • Retains roughly 1.5-second smooth jumps, Well Rested aura tracking, gradual quest rewards, click-to-type map search and separate test-account reporting.
  • World art and crowded-town performance work continues. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.45 (Readable Lanternhold homes)

  • Lanternhold's homes now have weathered timber grain that follows their boards and structural beams, with muted color and surface detail at ordinary gameplay distance.
  • A small, smooth cutaway reveals the hero when a nearby home's roof or wall blocks the camera, then closes as the hero walks clear. Foundations and building shadows remain solid.
  • Retains strolling residents, connected neighborhood lanes and blended town-to-Earth roads, click-to-type map search, gradual quest rewards, roughly 1.5-second jumps, smooth Well Rested tracking and separate test-account reporting.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. World art and crowded-town performance work continues. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.44 (Readable district streets)

  • Dark Realm buildings smoothly reveal the hero when roofs or walls block the camera, then become solid again as the hero walks clear. Roads, floors, collision and building shadows retain their original behavior.
  • District roofs now have matte mineral slate with staggered courses and consistent surface scale.
  • Ilyra shares duplicate animation calculations within each model while preserving her original appearance and equipment.
  • Retains Lanternhold's homes, strolling residents and blended gate roads, map shortcuts, gradual quest rewards, roughly 1.5-second jumps, smooth Well Rested tracking and separate test-account reporting.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. World art and crowded-town performance work continues. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.43 (Lanternhold neighborhoods)

  • Fifteen timber homes with slate roofs, framed windows and character-sized doors replace Lanternhold's outlying tents. Residential lanes connect the homes to town.
  • Mara, Dain, Hessa and Selen are spread through the neighborhoods. They stroll, stop to rest and pause near players for conversation, with smoothly interpolated movement and walking poses.
  • The four gates gradually blend town paving into the Earth Realm's dirt trails.
  • Combat and spell visual bursts can no longer fill the delivery lane reserved for inventory receipts, quest updates and essential encounter signals.
  • Includes the previous map shortcut correction and Dark Realm district improvements. Opening the map leaves search inactive until clicked, so M can close it again.
  • World art and performance work continues; this update does not declare final visual quality, feature freeze or closed beta. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.42

  • Opening the world map keeps search inactive until selected, so pressing M again closes the map.
  • Dark Realm district courts now have timber workbenches with cups, ledgers, books, foundry tools and scored bread, alongside folded cloth standards.
  • District buildings now have pitched roofs, framed pointed windows and distinct mooring spars, archive bands, hollow foundry flues and city crowns.

Alpha 1.79.41 (Streets beyond the veil)

  • Dark Realm streets have worn, irregular paving with shallow joints and mineral surface detail.
  • The expedition camp has tensioned canvas shelters, supported ridges and tied frames. Its four elemental lanterns now have stepped stone feet, tapered shafts and protective metal cages.
  • Water, Fire and Dark Realm waystones have distinct worn crowns and stone surfaces.
  • Retains gradual quest XP, larger dungeon story rewards and the two-level limit on any single quest turn-in.
  • Retains approximately 1.5-second jump arrival, smooth takeoff and landing, Well Rested aura tracking and separate automation-account population reporting.
  • Existing characters, items and Gold remain intact. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.
